ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a circular current-carrying wire placed in a uniform magnetic field. The magnetic field lines are horizontal and point to the right, labeled B. Three equal-length current elements are marked on the loop: a is near the top of the circle, b is on the right side, and c is on the lower-left side. From the local tangent directions of the circle, the element at b is closest to perpendicular to the magnetic field, the element at c is at an oblique angle to the magnetic field, and the element at a is closest to parallel or antiparallel to the magnetic field. Reasoning: The magnitude of the Ampere force on a current element is F = I B Δl sinθ, where θ is the angle between the current element direction and the magnetic field. Since I, B, and Δl are the same for the three elements, only sinθ determines the force magnitude. At b, θ is closest to 90°, so the force is largest. At c, θ is intermediate, so the force is smaller than at b. At a, θ is closest to 0° or 180°, so the force is smallest. Therefore the order is F_b > F_c > F_a.

先描述图像：图中有一个圆形载流导线，外加匀强磁场的多条箭头都水平向右，标为 \(\vec B\)。三个等长电流元分别位于圆环上的 \(a\)、\(b\)、\(c\)：\(a\) 在圆环上方附近，沿圆周切线方向看起来近似水平；\(b\) 在圆环右侧附近，沿圆周切线方向近似竖直；\(c\) 在左下侧附近，沿圆周切线方向相对水平磁场是倾斜的。
再推理：电流元在磁场中受安培力大小为 \(F=BI\Delta l\sin\theta\)，其中 \(\theta\) 是电流元方向与 \(\vec B\) 的夹角。三个电流元长度相等，电流相同，磁场也相同，所以只需比较它们相对于水平磁场的垂直分量大小。\(b\) 处电流元近似竖直，与水平 \(\vec B\) 夹角最大，受力最大；\(c\) 处电流元倾斜，垂直分量次之；\(a\) 处电流元近似水平，几乎与 \(\vec B\) 平行，垂直分量最小。因此大小顺序为 \(F_b>F_c>F_a\)。
